title: Scalable Posterior Uncertainty for Flexible Density-Based Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2603.03188v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Density-based clustering is a well-established framework that defines clusters through topological or geometric features of the data-generating density, yielding flexible procedures that have proven effective on large and complex datasets. We address the problem of obtaining scalable Bayesian-style uncertainty quantification by combining density-based clustering with martingale posterior distributions. Density uncertainty is first quantified through a fully parallelized predictive resampling scheme driven by model score functions, naturally accommodating modern differentiable density estimators such as normalizing flows. Posterior samples of the clustering are then obtained by applying density-based clustering to each random density sampled from the martingale posterior, enabling inference on any clustering-related quantity. Casting the estimand as a density functional also enables a rigorous frequentist convergence analysis. W

translated_title: 面向灵活的基于密度的聚类的可扩展后验不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 基于密度的聚类是一种成熟的框架，它通过数据生成密度的拓扑或几何特征来定义聚类，由此产生的灵活方法在大规模和复杂数据集上已被证明是有效的。我们通过将基于密度的聚类与鞅后验分布相结合，解决了获得可扩展的贝叶斯式不确定性量化的问题。密度的不确定性首先通过一种完全并行化的预测重采样方案来量化，该方案由模型得分函数驱动，自然地兼容诸如归一化流等现代可微密度估计器。随后，通过将从鞅后验中采样的每个随机密度进行基于密度的聚类，获得聚类的后验样本，从而能够对任何与聚类相关的量进行推断。将估计目标表示为密度泛函还使得严格的频率派收敛分析成为可能。
tldr: 该论文将基于密度的聚类与鞅后验分布相结合，提出了一种完全并行化、可扩展的贝叶斯不确定性量化框架，兼容归一化流等可微密度估计器，并能对任意聚类相关量进行推断，同时具备严格的频率派收敛性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper combines density-based clustering with martingale posterior distributions to achieve scalable Bayesian uncertainty quantification, featuring a fully parallelized predictive resampling scheme compatible with differentiable density estimators like normalizing flows, enabling inference on any clustering-related quantity with rigorous frequentist convergence guarantees.
